description: This file contains router definitions and API endpoint implementations for managing destinations within a travel planning backend, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy with async support. It includes functions for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting destination records, scoped to the current user and associated trips.

methods.name: Trip _get_trip_for_user(db: AsyncSession, trip_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a trip for a user by trip ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: list[DestinationOut] list_destinations( trip_id: int | None = None, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists destinations, optionally filtered by trip ID, scoped to current user.

methods.name: DestinationOut create_destination( payload: DestinationCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new destination under a trip after validating ownership.

methods.name: DestinationOut get_destination( destination_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a destination scoped to current user.

methods.name: DestinationOut update_destination( destination_id: int, payload: DestinationUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates an existing destination if it belongs to current user.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_destination( destination_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes a destination if it belongs to current user.
